project.name: GlobalTrade SCM :: Web Tier (JAX-RS)
project.description: REST facade over the EJB business tier. Depends on scm-ejb directly with `provided` scope (not scm-ejb-client, and not compile scope): this module is packaged into the same EAR as scm-ejb and calls its LOCAL interfaces in-process, so it needs the full artifact to compile against, but must not bundle a second copy of scm-ejb's classes into WEB-INF/lib — the EAR's own ejb module already provides them on the shared application classloader, and having both present is a classic duplicate-class Java EE classloading failure. See scm-ejb's own pom.xml for when the thin client jar (scm-ejb-client) is the right dependency instead — namely, for a consumer that is NOT packaged into this same EAR.
